cmd.help.title: Sensewright commands
cmd.help.body:
sw.chat <text> — chat with the selected Sim
 sw.hey — trigger a spontaneous greeting from the Sim
 sw.status — show sidecar status and provider health
 sw.reset [session|sim|save|all] — clear conversation/memory scope
 sw.forget [sim|save|all] — wipe memory for scope
 sw.autonomy <off|observe|suggest|semi|full> — set autonomy level for the Sim
 sw.agents [<seats>|<sim_id> <freq>] — show the agent roster or set the impulse dial
 sw.lang <auto|en|pt-BR> — set UI language (persists to config)
 sw.hud [on|off|now] — debug HUD: live in-game status of the loop
 sw.god — show the God controls
 sw.zeitgeist <tags_csv|auto> — set or suggest the neighborhood zeitgeist
 sw.profile <one sentence> — write this Sim's character profile
 sw.evolve [save] — run the reflection/evolution loop
 sw.probe — dump this Sim's autonomy surface to the log (dev)
 sw.uitest [kind|all|probe] — native-dialog spike for the panel (dev)
 sw.start — manually start the sidecar
 sw.help — show this help
